title: Every switch to the Gym tab asks the gym server about seven questions again, even seconds after the last time
what: Each time the member taps into the Gym tab, the app at once asks the gym for its shop list, the member's orders, the gym's name and look, the messages, the workout offer, the reminders and any unsent leave, with no wait between visits. Going back and forth between tabs repeats all of it. On a slow 4G phone this costs data and battery and slows the tab's other answers, though the screen keeps showing what it already had.
expected: Opening the tab again within a few minutes reuses what the phone already has (as the opening hours and diet plans already do), and only a pull to refresh asks for everything at once.
fix_line: Ask the gym again on tab open only when the last ask is a few minutes old; a pull still asks at once

items.reason: phone app gym screens only; no panel web pages here (pagespeed.json covers the panel and websites)
no watch code in the phone gym screens
